label: explicit_threat
pattern: i will (kill you|hurt you|find you)|dekh lunga|maar dunga|jaan se|chhodunga nahi

label: veiled_threat
pattern: warna jo hoga|dekh lena|tum pachta|you.?ll regret|see what happens|don.?t make me|anjaam|majboor mat kar
meaning: Implies consequences while avoiding an explicit threat

label: surveillance
pattern: i saw you|saw you at|you were wearing|maine dekha|dekha tumhe|kahan thi|kahan the tum|i.?m outside|outside your|tumhare ghar|i know where you|pata hai tum
meaning: Shows the sender is tracking the recipient’s movements

label: ownership
pattern: tum (sirf )?meri ho|sirf meri|you.?re mine|only mine|kisi aur se baat|mere alawa
meaning: Treats the recipient as a possession

label: guilt_trip
pattern: why are you ignor|why ignor|maine kya galat|after all i|you owe me|reply karo|answer me|tumne mujhe dhoka|mar jaunga|i will die|hurt myself
meaning: Pressures through guilt or emotional blackmail

label: refusal
pattern: leave me alone|stop (messaging|texting|calling|contacting)|i need (some )?(time|space)|not interested|don.?t (message|text|call|contact)|please stop|mujhe (time|space) chahiye|baat mat karo|pareshan mat karo|mujhe baat nahi karni
meaning: Clear request to stop or pause contact
